transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Um... well, I'm just having a hard time keeping things straight at work. I work at a dry cleaner and... it's just getting to be too much. The tickets, the receipts, notes about alterations... it all just ends up in a pile. I look at it and I just... I don't even know where to start anymore.
Were you having similar problems with paying attention or organizing things when you were a child?

Um... yeah, I guess I did. Even back in grade school, my teachers used to tell my mom that I was... bright, but just scattered. I was always talking out of turn, or... losing my papers. They always had to remind me to finish my work. So... yeah.
Have these problems with attention and organization been present since childhood, or did they start only later in life?
Um... well, like I just said... it's been since I was a kid. So... yeah, since childhood.
Have you been feeling depressed or down most days lately?
Um... no. Not really. Just... frustrated with work, mostly.
